note: Cropped near-tail crop of the NOAA operational BATS-R-US meridional (y=0) cut, exactly as published: same int16 coordinate quantisation, same uint16 field encoding, same uint8 masks. Nothing is resampled or recomputed here; only points outside the tail window were dropped, so any number a test measures from this is a number measured from NOAA output.

source.model: NOAA operational Geospace SWMF: BATS-R-US + RIM + RCM + RBE
source.coordinateSystem: GSM for MHD planes; magnetic local time/L shell for RBE
